answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own thread record, and its own share of the reef quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. The nebula ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 3208 identities would post 936 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
